Affected by this vulnerability is the function  default_user_role  of the component  Setting Handler . Performing a manipulation of the argument  role  results in improper privilege management.

This vulnerability was named  CVE-2026-5118 . The attack may be initiated remotely. There is no available exploit.

[vuldb] A vulnerability, which was classified as  critical , was found in  themefusion Avada Builder Plugin up to 3.15.2  on WordPress. This affects the function  Fusion_Builder_Conditional_Render_Helper::get_value  of the component  AJAX Endpoint . Such manipulation leads to injection.
